 Press Release 
 April 8, 2026   
 Medicare Rights Center Launches Fact Sheet Series on What’s at Stake for Older Adults and People With Disabilities in 2026
 New York, NY —The Medicare Rights Center today launched What’s at Stake for Older Adults and People With Disabilities , an educational series examining how changes to Medicare, Medicaid, and the Affordable Care Act (ACA) could affect health coverage and costs for older adults and people with disabilities. The series is designed to help older adults and their families, advocates, and policymakers better understand these proposals as national conversations on health care policy continue.
 Many of the policies in the series are longstanding proposals, having been debated by lawmakers for decades, introduced in bill after bill, including sweeping Medicaid cuts, that are already underway. The series launches today with all 10 fact sheets, a summary infographic, and the first part of a two-part explainer video. Beginning this month, the Medicare Rights Center will spotlight one fact sheet per month, pairing each with a plain-language article that explains the policies’ direct impacts on coverage and costs.
 “These policy proposals have real consequences for older adults and people with disabilities, whether or not they’re in the headlines on any given day,” said Fred Riccardi, President of the Medicare Rights Center. “As current and future beneficiaries of the Medicare program, it is important that people understand the value of these programs and how changes may impact their ability to access and afford care in the future.”
 The 10 policy topics covered by the series span the ACA, Medicare, and Medicaid and reflect a range of structural and financing changes that have been proposed or enacted in recent years:
 The Affordable Care Act
 Medicaid Cuts
 Medicaid Financing
 Medicaid Waivers
 Administrative Barriers
 Raising the Medicare Eligibility Age
 The Inflation Reduction Act
 Medicare Premium Support
 Medicare Private Contracting
 Medicare Means Testing
 For each topic, the fact sheets document what current law provides, what has recently changed, and what further changes are under discussion, giving readers a clear picture of where things stand and what’s at stake. The series begins with the ACA’s protections for older adults. Part two of the explainer video and a second infographic examining financial impacts will follow in the coming months.
 The full series, including today’s spotlight on the ACA, video series, and all future releases, can be found at https://www.medicarerights.org/policy-series/whats-at-stake .
